workflowDefinition.description: Chaos Commerce returns. Drags the return through six pointless departmental checks (each waits in a queue, none can affect the outcome, the loop is capped), then hands the case to chaos_return_verdict for the actual decision. Uses system tasks only, so no worker has to be running, and falls back to chaos_return_rescue on any failure: every return reaches a decision.
workflowDefinition.name: chaos_return
